name: owned_s1_model_pause
logic_name: Owned System One pause around heavy execution

test_list.description: A paused native actor rejects queued and new inference work.
Monotonic epochs prevent an old release from reopening admission.
Apply the host pause before publishing a replacement worker connection.
Hold the owned pause through execution and sandbox teardown.
Dropping a lease does not silently resume inference or allow a later build to overwrite the abandoned epoch.
Kernel recovery refuses to resume while reaper sandbox ownership remains.
Recover an uncertain release by acknowledging and releasing a fresh epoch; stale messages cannot reopen another owner.
After accepted execution setup fails, publish exact-bound blocked proof and terminal execution evidence.
Cancellation before backend create only releases its intent; it does not destroy a resource it never created.

inputs.name: pause
inputs.description: Kernel-owned build pause, independent of model tool arguments.

output_type: Result<owned pause lease or acknowledged release, error>
output_description: Explicit native pause, eviction and resume. Verification deferred until the final pass by user instruction.
